# Shah Software Solution

> Malaysian software development company (SSM 202403307959, CT0143545-X) that designs and builds websites, mobile apps, business systems, IoT and UI/UX design for businesses in Malaysia. Website packages start from RM399 with domain, 1 year of hosting and SSL included. Works in English and Bahasa Melayu.

- Website: https://www.ssoftwaresolution.com/
- Contact: WhatsApp +60 11-1419 6505, info@ssoftwaresolution.com
- Last updated: 2026-10-25

## Website packages (MYR, starting prices)

- Landing Page, from RM399: 1 page, basic SEO, contact or WhatsApp button, domain and hosting for 1 year, SSL, 3 months support. About 1 week.
- Corporate Website, from RM899: 5 to 7 pages, contact form and Google Map, SEO setup, domain and hosting for 1 year, SSL, 6 months support. 1 to 2 weeks.
- E-Commerce Website, from RM1,299: unlimited products, customer accounts, FPX and card payment, order management, domain and hosting for 1 year, SSL. 2 to 3 weeks.
- Website & System, from RM2,999: login and logout, admin panel, database and custom features. 3 to 6 weeks.

## Other packages (MYR, starting prices)

- Mobile app: Basic App from RM2,999, Cross-platform App from RM4,999, Premium Custom App from RM11,999.
- Business system: Starter System from RM1,999, Business System from RM3,999, Company-wide System from RM7,999.
- IoT: Prototype from RM1,999, Pilot from RM4,999, Production from RM11,999.
- UI/UX design: Basic Design from RM499, Pro Design from RM1,499, Complete Suite from RM3,999.

IoT prices exclude hardware. Add-on features cost RM300 to RM1,500 each. Full detail: https://www.ssoftwaresolution.com/pricing.md

## Licence

All prices are for a licence to use the software for your business. The source code stays the property of Shah Software Solution: it may not be copied, modified or resold. Owning the source code is priced separately. Business data belongs to the client and can be exported.

## How projects are paid

Three phases: 30% to start design, 40% when the design is approved and building starts, 30% before launch. Maintenance after launch is quoted separately.

## Live demos

- [Nusa HR](https://demo-hrms.ssoftwaresolution.com/): HR system for attendance, leave, claims and payroll.
- [Stageflow](https://demo-eventoperation.ssoftwaresolution.com/): event operations, from planning to a live event-day control room.
- [Gilir](https://demo-servicequeue.ssoftwaresolution.com/): service queue where customers take a number from their phone.
- [Tableline](https://demo-restaurantqueue.ssoftwaresolution.com/r/BAYU-PJ): restaurant waitlist with table-ready notices.
- [Folk Barber](https://demo-booking.ssoftwaresolution.com/services): booking system for services, staff and time slots.
- [Sora Parfum](https://demo-ecommerce.ssoftwaresolution.com/): online store with product pages, bag and checkout.
- [Ruang Studio](https://demo-landingpage.ssoftwaresolution.com/): landing page built to get consultation bookings.
